title: The Cost of Having a Conscience
seoTitle: The Cost of Having a Conscience | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal essay on ethics in capitalist society, work–life balance, insecurity, and the difficult gap between moral principles and everyday choices.
deck: On work, insecurity and the distance between principle and practice
heroAlt: An illustrated weighing scale balancing a living green plant against stacked account ledgers, representing ethics, work and economic pressure.
heroCaption: The tension between what we believe and the choices we make.

sources.name: Adam Smith — The Theory of Moral Sentiments, Part I, Section I, Chapter I
sources.context: Smith's opening discussion of sympathy and concern for others.

sources.name: Karl Marx — Capital, Volume I, Chapter 10: The Working-Day
sources.context: Discussion of limits on working time and of time beyond work.

sources.name: Mirza Ghalib — bas-ki dushvaar hai har kaam kaa aasaan honaa (ghazal)
sources.context: Original Urdu couplet and its attribution; the English rendering in the essay is the author's interpretation.
